full_page.content:
1932, January
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 15 Jan. 10 James Eagen - 39 - of Smith's Creek, Mich. - Enrolled a week yesterday ( thought to be ulcers of stomach or cancer) comes to-day drives own car 52 miles and enrolls perpetually in thanksgiving is quite O.K. Febr. 29th James Egan had promised Jan. 10 to enroll the Poor Souls for half of X ray ($25) if he were able to forget about ? To-day he paid last of the ($14) he promised. He felt excellently. November 13th Eagen's cousin from Smith's Creek, Mich.
Mrs. Sophie Heffernan - 36 - goes blind three days before birth of baby - Dr. had very little hope of the survival, is enrolled for one year in S.M.A. promising perpetual Enrollment if things go favorably ... March Baby born O.K. and mother's sight perfectly restored. Deo Gr.
Jan. 11 Prayers ... for John Riordan ... silent (morose) refused to speak with his family.
Anna Sterniger - cancer of breast "hopeless" .... Alphonse Dyscez
Pietro Scolaro - N. 1317 Coplin
Baby Dominic Grillo (17 months) Pneum'a & obstruction of lungs Mrs. Epileptic
Jan. 13 Walter Kolar in Herm. Kiefer Hosp'1 8 yrs. - diphtheria ....... Sister Mary Ann - 2 yrs. blind - tumor on brain - operation ex- pected soon.
Page 16 Jan. 14 Christian J. Taylor - 38 - ulcers of stomach. Has wife and 7 small children and is afraid of operation - enrolled To-day Margaret Manning - operation to-morrow - mastoids
Yvonne Renard - 37 - operated on ten years ago - fears another operation on breast.
Ambrose Sloan - 53 - of Jackson, Mich. operated two years ago for cancerous tumor - They had grafted from his shoulder to cure the wound which seemed a success for but after a year broke loose a- gain. Then they came to the Monastery and enrolled in the S.M.Ass'n and it healed to remain evermore OK.
